overview_description.description:
Dubai Islamic Bank is a provider of financial products and services.

It offers corporate, as well as, personal, SME, and priority banking services and gives its users access to conventional cash management, online payments, business financing, and saving services. The company also operates wealth management, financing, investment banking, treasury product, and capital market division.

The Dubai, Dubai-based company was formed by Haj Saeed Bin Ahmed Al Lootah in 1975.

about_short_description.short_description: Dubai Islamic Bank is a provider of financial products and services.

product.name: Personal Accounts
product.description: Sharia-compliant current, savings and salary accounts for individuals to manage deposits, payments, salary credits and everyday banking.

product.name: Personal Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant consumer financing for personal needs, with structured repayment through monthly instalments.

product.name: Home Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant property financing for purchasing homes and other eligible residential properties across the UAE.

product.name: Covered Cards
product.description: Sharia-compliant payment cards for purchases, cash access and card-related services, with repayment and reward features based on the selected card.

product.name: Auto Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant vehicle financing for purchasing eligible cars, motorcycles and electric vehicles through scheduled instalments.

product.name: Business Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant financing for businesses, supporting working capital, asset acquisition and other corporate funding requirements.
